name: BirMakon
tagline: Multi-vendor shopping app, plus a companion app for sellers
role: Buyer and seller mobile apps by the Softwhere team

scenes.title: One storefront, many shops
scenes.body: A promo carousel, brand and shop rows, then horizontal product shelves with sale prices and add-to-cart.

scenes.title: Catalog and filters
scenes.body: A category grid, plus filters for price range, brands, colors, sizes and season.

scenes.title: Product page with bulk prices
scenes.body: Quantity price tiers sit beside the price, then color swatches, sizes, delivery terms and buy buttons.

scenes.title: Cart split by shop
scenes.body: Items are grouped per seller; checkout takes delivery and recipient details; orders show status categories.

scenes.title: A companion app for sellers
scenes.body: A separate React Native app: daily sales summary, product cards with on/off switches, per-quantity prices.
